items.name: Eng
items.why: Staging reports stall when repro, the unsent issue, and the risk review live in one undifferentiated chat.

items.name: Loop
items.why: Inner-loop coding agents still need an outer evidence/verdict loop before anyone merges, tags, or writes the ship rationale.

items.name: Marketing
items.why: Competitor noise, channel variants, and the weekly issue get mixed until someone diffs, remixes, and still does not publish.

items.name: Meta
items.why: Standing up a catalog team, cutting a bloated fleet, routing work, and minting the next contract are four jobs, not one Setup dump.

items.name: Ops
items.why: The week hides in Slack, receipts, and vendor mail until someone maps it to priorities without sending a chase.

items.name: Personal
items.why: Inbox zero fails when mail, meetings, and unused subs are one Bot that is tempted to send, decline, and unsubscribe.

items.name: Product
items.why: Latency, Slack asks, and launch day collide unless one Bot owns evidence, one clusters asks, and one refuses to publish.

items.name: Research
items.why: Deep briefs, three-minute answers, and assumption hunts are different jobs; mixing them hides the not-found list.

items.name: Sales
items.why: Outbound volume is useless if the next call is unbriefed and the recap never gets written down before it is sent.

items.name: Success
items.why: Renewals slip when health is a vibe, replies go out uncited, and promises evaporate after the call.
